questions.question: You see a solid yellow line and a broken yellow line in the center. The broken line is next to your lane. When can you pass?

options.text: Only in an emergency.
If you are on an expressway.
If traffic is clear.
Only at an intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: If traffic is clear.
questions.explanation: When a broken yellow line is next to your lane and a solid yellow line is on the other side, you may pass if no oncoming traffic is coming.

questions.question: What color are warning signs that show upcoming hazards?

options.text: Black letters or symbols on a white background
Black letters or symbols on a yellow background
White letters or symbols on a blue background
White letters or symbols on a green background

questions.correctAnswerText: Black letters or symbols on a yellow background
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. Work zone warning signs are orange with black letters or symbols.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is merging from another road. Give drivers space to merge safely into traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from another road. Give drivers space to merge safely into traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will merge ahead. Check your mirrors and side. Move to another lane if you can to give merging drivers a clear path.

questions.question: Before you leave a parallel parking space, you should:

options.text: Sound your horn.
Turn on your four-way flashers.
Look for traffic by turning your head.
Look for traffic by using only your inside rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look for traffic by turning your head.
questions.explanation: Before leaving a parking space, turn your head to check your blind spots. Look for pedestrians, bicyclists, motorcycles, and other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
A bus stop is ahead.
You are entering a school's parking lot.
A school zone is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A school zone is ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What do double solid yellow lines down the center of a road mean for passing?

options.text: Allowed from both directions.
Allowed only from your direction of travel.
Not allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not allowed from either direction.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no driver in either direction may cross the centerline to pass.

questions.question: Drivers who drink and drive are:

options.text: Not a problem in New York State.
A danger to every driver on the road.
A problem only for police to handle.
Only a problem for those who drink.

questions.correctAnswerText: A danger to every driver on the road.
questions.explanation: Any driver who is impaired or intoxicated is dangerous to themselves and everyone else on the road.

questions.question: What should you do when another car is tailgating you?

options.text: Move to the right if there is an open lane.
If there is no right lane, wait until the road ahead is clear and slowly reduce your speed so the tailgater will pass you.
Never brake suddenly.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Move right if you can. If not, wait until the road is clear ahead, then slow down gradually to let the tailgater pass. Never brake suddenly, as this increases the risk of a crash.

questions.question: An oncoming car is heading toward you in your lane. What should you do?

options.text: Honk, steer right, and speed up.
Honk, steer left, and brake.
Honk, steer right, and brake.
Stay centered, honk, and brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Honk, steer right, and brake.
questions.explanation: Honk to warn the other driver. If they don't move, steer right to escape. Do not steer left because if they swerve at the last moment, you will still collide. Brake firmly to reduce the impact.

questions.question: You hit a parked car and can't find the owner. What must you do?

options.text: Call your insurance company when you get home.
Wait for the owner to return.
Leave a note with your name and address on the car.

questions.correctAnswerText: Leave a note with your name and address on the car.
questions.explanation: If you hit a parked car, you must attach a note with your name, phone number, and address to the car you hit.

questions.question: To pass a slower vehicle on a two-lane, two-way road, you must:

options.text: Not cross the centerline.
Flash your lights at oncoming traffic.
Use the shoulder.
Use the lane for oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use the lane for oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: To pass on a two-lane, two-way road, you must use the oncoming lane to complete your pass. Only pass if it is safe and legal to do so.

questions.question: A flashing red light means:

options.text: The same thing as a stop sign.
The traffic signal is broken.
You do not have to stop completely.
Driving conditions are dangerous.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same thing as a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Come to a complete stop, let pedestrians and traffic pass, and only go when it is safe.

questions.question: When you see a flashing red traffic light, you should:

options.text: Drive through if there is no other traffic.
Keep driving because you have the right-of-way.
Stop only if a police officer is nearby.
Treat it like a stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: Flashing red lights are at dangerous intersections. Treat them like stop signs.

questions.question: What happens if you refuse a chemical test?

options.text: There is no evidence against you for drunk driving.
You cannot be arrested for drunk driving.
Your license will be taken away.
None of these choices.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your license will be taken away.
questions.explanation: By driving, you agree to take a chemical test if arrested for alcohol or drug violations. If you refuse the test, your license will be suspended. If a DMV hearing confirms your refusal, your license will be revoked, even if you are found not guilty of the original charge.

questions.question: You see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights behind you on a city street. What should you do?

options.text: Move to the right edge and slow down.
Move to the right edge and stop.
Stay in your lane, slow down, and let it pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the right edge and stop.
questions.explanation: You must let emergency vehicles pass. Move to the right edge of the road and stop until the vehicle passes. If you are in an intersection, drive through it first, then stop.

questions.question: You have the right-of-way when you are:

options.text: Entering a traffic circle.
Backing out of a driveway.
Leaving a parking space.
Already inside a traffic circle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Already inside a traffic circle.
questions.explanation: Drivers already inside a traffic circle have the right-of-way over entering drivers. Drivers leaving driveways and parking spaces must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.question: Bicyclists are not required to:

options.text: Obey the same traffic laws.
Signal all turns.
Report accidents with serious injuries.
Insure the bicycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Insure the bicycle.
questions.explanation: Bicyclists must obey the same traffic laws as drivers. Any bicycle crash causing death or serious injury must be reported to the DMV within 10 days.

questions.question: The best way to prevent hydroplaning is to:

options.text: Keep your tires in good condition.
Slow down on wet or slushy roads.
Watch for standing water and puddles.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: On wet roads, cars need more distance to stop and may skid when turning. Do not use cruise control in wet or icy conditions. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop Sign Ahead.
Side Road.
Railroad Warning.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop Sign Ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a stop sign is coming.

questions.question: Minimum speed signs are designed to:

options.text: Keep traffic flowing smoothly.
Show current road conditions.
Test future traffic signal needs.
Ensure pedestrian safety.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep traffic flowing smoothly.
questions.explanation: Minimum speed limits keep traffic moving smoothly. Driving too slowly can slow traffic and create dangerous conditions. You can be cited for driving below the minimum speed limit.
